client.title: 客户端 Client
zh: 只影响本机客户端。保存后立即生效（个别项需重连或重启）。
共 27 项，与 config/create/client.json 一一对应。
en: Client-only settings; applied right after saving.

server.title: 服务端 Server
zh: 联机时以服务端为准：改这里只影响本机单人世界，服务器读自己的 config/create/server.json。
共 101 项，与 config/create/server.json 一一对应。
en: Not synced server->client in multiplayer: the server's own file wins.

common.title: 通用 Common
zh: 世界生成相关，只在单人世界内立即生效；联机时由服务端决定。
共 1 项，与 config/create/common.json 一一对应。
en: World-generation related; singleplayer only, the server decides in multiplayer.

desc: 看向"超载(Overstressed)"的机械部件时显示提示框。
en: Display a tooltip when looking at overstressed components.

desc: 按住 Shift 显示物品说明、按住 Ctrl 显示操作提示。
en: Show item descriptions on Shift and controls on Ctrl.

desc: 移动装置渲染出错时在日志里打印完整堆栈（排查问题时开）。
en: Log a stack-trace when rendering issues happen within a moving contraption.

desc: 鼓风机吹出的粒子密度，数值越大粒子越多。默认 0.5
en: Higher density means more spawned particles.

desc: 【单位: 方块】过滤器槽位里的物品，在玩家多少格内才渲染。默认 10
en: Maximum Distance to the player at which items in Blocks' filter slots will be displayed

desc: 透过巧克力看东西时的视野距离倍率。默认 1.0
en: The vision range though chocolate will be multiplied by this factor

desc: 透过蜂蜜看东西时的视野距离倍率。默认 1.0
en: The vision range through honey will be multiplied by this factor

desc: 浮层背景色（ARGB 整数）。默认 -267386864
en: The custom background color to use for the Goggle- and Hover- Overlays, if enabled

desc: 浮层边框渐变的下端颜色（ARGB 整数）。默认 1344798847
en: The custom bot color of the border gradient to use for the Goggle- and Hover- Overlays, if enabled

desc: 浮层边框渐变的上端颜色（ARGB 整数）。默认 1347420415
en: The custom top color of the border gradient to use for the Goggle- and Hover- Overlays, if enabled

desc: 开启后，护目镜/悬停浮层使用下面自定义的颜色。
en: Enable this to use your custom colors for the Goggle- and Hover- Overlay

desc: 护目镜/悬停信息浮层的横向像素偏移。默认 20
en: Offset the overlay from goggle- and hover- information by this many pixels on the respective axis; Use /create overlay

desc: 护目镜/悬停信息浮层的纵向像素偏移。默认 0
en: Offset the overlay from goggle- and hover- information by this many pixels on the respective axis; Use /create overlay

desc: 设为 true 后，使用「极佳(Fabulous)」画质时 Create 不再发送兼容性警告。
en: Setting this to true will prevent Create from sending you a warning when playing with Fabulous graphics enabled

desc: ESC 菜单里按钮的横向像素偏移。默认 -4
en: Offset the Create config button in the in-game menu by this many pixels on the X axis
The sign (-/+) of this value determines what side of the row the button appears on (left/right)

desc: Create 配置按钮出现在 ESC 菜单的第几行；0 = 不显示按钮。默认 3
en: Choose the menu row that the Create config button appears on in the in-game menu
Set to 0 to disable the button altogether

desc: 按钮横向偏移的像素数；正负决定按钮靠左还是靠右。默认 -4
en: Offset the Create config button in the main menu by this many pixels on the X axis
The sign (-/+) of this value determines what side of the row the button appears on (left/right)

desc: Create 配置按钮出现在主菜单的第几行；0 = 不显示按钮。默认 2
en: Choose the menu row that the Create config button appears on in the main menu
Set to 0 to disable the button altogether

desc: 配方查看器(JEI/REI)搜索框与「仓储管理员库存终端」的搜索如何联动。
en: How Recipe Viewer search should interact with Stock Keepers
Allowed Values: SYNC_BOTH, SYNC_FROM_JEI, SYNC_FROM_STOCK_KEEPER, NONE

desc: 设为 false 后，坐在移动装置上时视角不会被带着旋转。
en: Disable to prevent being rotated while seated on a Moving Contraption

desc: 环境音的最大音量系数（0~1）。默认 0.1
en: Maximum volume modifier of Ambient noise

desc: 打开 Create 的环境音：齿轮咔哒、机械轰鸣。
en: Make cogs rumble and machines clatter.

desc: 坐在火车上时相机拉远的倍率。默认 3.0
en: How far away the Camera should zoom when seated on a train

desc: 在上一项基础上，额外显示铁路网络各段的材料。
en: Additionally display materials of a Rail Network while f3 debug mode is active

desc: F3 调试模式下显示铁路网络的节点与连线。
en: Display nodes and edges of a Railway Network while f3 debug mode is active

desc: 在支持的地图 mod 上显示铁路网络与列车（JourneyMap 等）。
en: Display Track Networks and Trains on supported map mods

desc: 地图上铁路网络的颜色主题。
背罐最大储气量 = 水下可呼吸秒数。默认900
en: The Maximum volume of Air that can be stored in a backtank = Seconds of underwater breathing

desc: 背罐"容量"附魔每级额外增加多少空气。默认300
en: The volume of Air added by each level of the backtanks Capacity Enchantment

desc: 一罐铜背罐能供延长抓手用多少次(0 = 抓手永久用不坏)。默认1000
en: Amount of free Extendo Grip actions provided by one filled Copper Backtank. Set to 0 makes Extendo Grips unbreakable

desc: 一罐铜背罐能供马铃薯加农炮发射多少次(0 = 无限)。默认200
en: Amount of free Potato Cannon shots provided by one filled Copper Backtank. Set to 0 makes Potato Cannons unbreakable

desc: 对称之杖触发镜像的最远距离。默认50
en: The Maximum Distance to an active mirror for the symmetry wand to trigger.

desc: 放置辅助: 摆放的方块离交互点最远多少格有效。默认12
en: The Maximum Distance a Block placed by Create's placement assist will have to its interaction point.

desc: 工具箱能直接操作玩家背包的最远距离。默认10
en: The Maximum Distance at which a Toolbox can interact with Players' Inventories.

desc: 哪些流体允许被无限抽取: ALLOW_ALL=全部; DENY_ALL=全部禁止; ALLOW_BY_TAG=仅允许打标签的; DENY_BY_TAG=按标签禁止
可选值: ALLOW_ALL, DENY_ALL, ALLOW_BY_TAG, DENY_BY_TAG
en: Configure which fluids can be drained infinitely.
Allowed Values: ALLOW_ALL, DENY_ALL, ALLOW_BY_TAG, DENY_BY_TAG

desc: 遇到超过阈值的"无限源"时, 软管滑轮是否继续抽/灌
en: Whether hose pulleys should continue filling up above-threshold sources.

desc: 软管滑轮是否允许放置流体源方块(用于灌满)
en: Whether hose pulleys should be allowed to place fluid sources.

desc: 流体储罐每格方块能装几桶液体。默认8
en: The amount of liquid a tank can hold per block.

desc: 流体储罐最高能叠几格。默认32
en: The maximum height a fluid tank can reach.

desc: 判定为"无限水源"所需的最小流体方块数(-1 = 关闭此判定)。默认10000
en: The minimum amount of fluid blocks the hose pulley needs to find before deeming it an infinite source.

desc: 软管滑轮最多能抽多远以外的流体(方块)。默认128
en: The maximum distance a hose pulley can draw fluid blocks from.

desc: 机械泵单侧推/吸液体的最大距离(方块)。默认16
en: The maximum distance a mechanical pump can push or pull liquids on either side.

desc: 敞口管道是否允许放置流体源方块
en: Whether open-ended pipes should be allowed to place fluid sources.

desc: 服务器每隔多少刻发送一次"刻速同步"包(卡顿/低TPS时让动画更同步)。默认20
en: The amount of time a server waits before sending out tickrate synchronization packets.
These packets help animations to be more accurate when tps is below 20.

desc: 紫水晶母岩能否被装置移动(取值同上)
en: Configure how Budding Amethyst can be moved by contraptions.

desc: 收割机是否连未长熟的作物一起割掉
en: Whether harvesters should break crops that aren't fully grown.

desc: 收割机收完后是否自动补种
en: Whether harvesters should replant crops after harvesting.

desc: 单个移动装置最多能带多少方块一起动。默认2048
en: Maximum amount of blocks in a structure movable by Pistons, Bearings or other means.

desc: 两辆矿车最多能相距多远仍算连接。默认32
en: Maximum allowed distance of two coupled minecarts.

desc: 机架最大吸附连接范围。默认16
en: Maximum value of a chassis attachment range.

desc: 机械活塞后方最多接几根延长杆。默认64
en: Maximum amount of extension poles behind a Mechanical Piston.

desc: 绳索滑轮一次最多放多长绳索。默认384
en: Max length of rope available off a Rope Pulley.

desc: 矿车装置是否允许被装进容器类物品里
en: Whether minecart contraptions can be placed into container items.

desc: 黑曜石能否被装置移动(取值同上)
en: Configure how Obsidian blocks can be moved by contraptions.

desc: 强化深板岩能否被装置移动(取值同上)
en: Configure how Reinforced Deepslate blocks can be moved by contraptions.

desc: 刷怪笼能否被装置移动: MOVABLE=能移动; NO_PICKUP=能移动但不能收走; UNMOVABLE=不能动
en: Configure how Spawner blocks can be moved by contraptions.

desc: 装置采掘/收获到的物品是否自动放进装置携带的容器里
en: Whether items mined or harvested by contraptions should be placed in their mounted storage.

desc: 装置被放进实心方块内时是否阻止方块掉落
en: Whether to prevent block dropping when contraption is placed inside in-world blocks.

desc: 机械压路机一次最多填多深的方块。默认12
en: Maximum depth of blocks filled in using a Mechanical Roller.

kinetics.contraptions.stabiliseStableCon.zh: 稳定轴承独立实体〔技术项〕
desc: (技术项)稳定轴承对"非旋转"装置是否也生成独立实体
en: Whether stabilised bearings create a separated entity even on non-rotating contraptions.

desc: 生存模式是否能把矿车装置收进物品栏带走
en: Whether minecart contraptions can be picked up in survival mode.

kinetics.contraptions.syncPlayerPickupHi.zh: 玩家碰撞箱随装置〔技术项〕
desc: (技术项)玩家站在装置上时碰撞箱是否随装置变大
en: Whether the players hitbox should be expanded to the size of the contraption hitbox.

desc: 摇曲柄消耗饥饿的速度倍率(0~1)。默认0.01
en: multiplier used for calculating exhaustion from speed when a crank is turned.

desc: 粉碎轮运转时造成的伤害值。默认4
en: Damage dealt by active Crushing Wheels.

desc: 彻底关闭"应力(SU)"机制。关闭后机器不消耗应力、不看容量(大幅降低难度, 慎用)
弹射器抛出的物品每隔多少刻扫描一次路径上可能的碰撞物。默认120
en: Time in ticks until the next item launched by an ejector scans blocks for potential collisions

desc: 鼓风机每隔多少刻检查一次有没有东西挡风。默认30
en: Game ticks between Fans checking for anything blocking their air flow.

desc: 鼓风机加工(吹干/烟熏等)配方需要多少刻。默认150
en: Game ticks required for a Fan-based processing recipe to take effect.

desc: 鼓风机能从多远吸住实体。默认20
en: Maximum distance in blocks from where Fans can pull entities.

desc: 鼓风机能把实体推出多远。默认20
en: Maximum distance in blocks Fans can push entities.

desc: 转速达到多少时鼓风机效果封顶。默认256
en: Rotation speed at which the maximum stats of fans are reached.

desc: 哪些生物被机械手攻击时会无视(不还手)。默认CREEPERS=只有苦力怕会无视; ALL=全部; NONE=无
en: Select what mobs should ignore Deployers when attacked by them.

desc: 动力方块每隔多少刻检查一次动力来源是否仍然有效。默认60
en: Game ticks between Kinetic Blocks checking whether their source is still valid.

desc: 传动带最大长度(方块数)。默认20
en: Maximum length in blocks of mechanical belts.

desc: 每条链式传送带最多可有几个连接点。默认4
en: Maximum amount of connections each chain conveyor can have.

desc: 链式传送带单条最大连接长度。默认32
en: Maximum length in blocks of chain conveyor connections.

desc: 加权弹射器最远能把物品扔多远(方块)。默认32
en: Max Distance in blocks a Weighted Ejector can throw

desc: 任意动力方块允许的最高转速。默认256
en: Maximum allowed rotation speed for any Kinetic Block.

desc: 风车成功组装至少需要多少块风帆类方块。默认8
en: Amount of sail-type blocks required for a windmill to assemble successfully.

desc: 转速达到多少转/分算"高速"。默认100
en: Minimum speed of rotation to be considered 'fast'

desc: 动力源应力容量达到多少算"高"。默认1024
en: Minimum added Capacity by sources to be considered 'high'

desc: 应力消耗达到多少算"高影响"。默认8
en: Minimum stress impact to be considered 'high'

desc: 动力源应力容量达到多少算"中等"。默认256
en: Minimum added Capacity by sources to be considered 'medium'

desc: 转速达到多少转/分算"中速"(用于仪表显示)。默认30
en: Minimum speed of rotation to be considered 'medium'

desc: 应力消耗达到多少算"中等影响"。默认4
en: Minimum stress impact to be considered 'medium'

desc: 每想提升1转/分, 需要额外加多少风帆。默认8
en: Number of sail-type blocks required to increase windmill speed by 1RPM.

desc: 黄铜隧道两次分流之间的等待刻数。默认10
en: The amount of ticks a brass tunnel waits between distributions.

desc: 链式传送带同一时间最多携带几个包裹。默认20
en: The amount of packages a chain conveyor can carry at a time.

desc: 漏斗没有被红石再次触发时, 两次抽物品之间的间隔刻。默认8
en: The amount of ticks a funnel waits between item transferrals, when it is not re-activated by redstone.

desc: 展示板连接器与目标屏最远距离。默认64
en: Maximum possible distance in blocks between display links and their target.

desc: 工厂仪表两次读取请求之间的间隔刻。默认100
en: The amount of ticks a factory gauge waits between requests.

desc: 红石信号连接器最远连接范围(方块)。默认256
en: Maximum possible range in blocks of redstone link connections.

desc: 机械臂最远能伸到的距离(方块)。默认5
en: Maximum distance in blocks a Mechanical Arm can reach across.

desc: 包裹端口能放在离目标多远处。默认5
en: Maximum distance in blocks a Package Port can be placed at from its target.

desc: 便携存储接口最多等多少刻完成传输, 然后放装置继续走。默认60
en: The amount of ticks a portable storage interface waits for transfers until letting contraptions move along.

desc: 敌对生物路过座椅时是否会自己坐上去
en: Whether hostile mobs walking near a seat will start riding it.

desc: 保险库每格方块能存几"组"物品。默认20
en: The total amount of stacks a vault can hold per block in size.

desc: 是否允许用"机械搅拌器+工作盆"酿造药水
en: Allow supported potions to be brewed by a Mechanical Mixer + Basin.

desc: 是否允许注液器与匠魂(Tinkers)铸造台/盆互动(没装匠魂则无影响)
en: Allow Spouts to interact with Casting Tables and Basins from Tinkers' Construct.

desc: 是否允许普通合成配方在机械合成器里完成
en: Allow any standard crafting recipes to be processed by Mechanical Crafters.

desc: 是否允许"单材料 2x2/3x3"配方在冲压机+盆中完成
en: Allow any single-ingredient 2x2 or 3x3 crafting recipes to be processed by a Mechanical Press + Basin.

desc: 是否允许任意"无序合成"配方在搅拌器+盆中完成
en: Allow any shapeless crafting recipes to be processed by a Mechanical Mixer + Basin.

desc: 是否允许石切配方在机械锯上完成
en: Allow any stonecutting recipes to be processed by a Mechanical Saw.

desc: 是否允许机械锯一次处理整组物品
en: Allow the Mechanical Saw to process entire stacks at a time.

desc: 是否允许机械冲压机一次处理整组(64个)物品
en: Allow the Mechanical Press to process entire stacks at a time.

desc: 是否在JEI里显示原版"斧去皮"的互动配方
en: Display vanilla Log-stripping interactions in JEI.

desc: 是否启用标准的精炼光辉(世界内合成)配方
en: Allow the standard in-world Refined Radiance recipes.

desc: 是否启用标准的暗影钢(世界内合成)配方
en: Allow the standard in-world Shadow Steel recipe.

desc: 生成"精炼光辉"需要消耗掉多少个光源。默认10
en: The amount of Light sources destroyed before Chromatic Compound turns into Refined Radiance.

desc: 机械合成器做烟花火箭最多可用多少种材料。默认9
en: The Maximum amount of ingredients that can be used to craft Firework Rockets using Mechanical Crafters.

desc: 创造模式直接放蓝图时, 是否用空气替换掉原有方块
en: Whether placing a Schematic directly in Creative Mode should replace world blocks with Air

desc: 上传蓝图时的分包大小(字节)。默认1024
en: The maximum packet size uploaded Schematics are split into.

desc: 每个玩家最多存几张蓝图(超出会覆盖最早的)。默认10
en: The amount of Schematics a player can upload until previous ones are overwritten.

desc: 上传蓝图文件的大小上限(千字节)。默认256
en: The maximum allowed file size of uploaded Schematics.

desc: 上传中途多少刻没收到新数据就判定超时放弃。默认600
en: Amount of game ticks without new packets arriving until an active schematic upload process is discarded.

desc: 蓝图大炮两发之间的间隔刻(越大越慢)。默认10 —— 注意: 你当前设为1(极快)
en: Amount of game ticks between shots of the cannon. Higher => Slower

desc: 每份火药能让蓝图大炮打印多少方块。默认400
en: Amount of blocks a Schematicannon can print per Gunpowder item provided.

desc: 手动驾驶速度 = 时刻表自动驾驶速度的多少倍。默认0.75
en: Relative speed of a manually controlled Train compared to a Scheduled one.

desc: 火车站"编组轨道"最大长度。默认128
en: Maximum length of a Train Stations' assembly track.

desc: 一列火车最多组装几个转向架(车底轮架)。默认20
en: Maximum amount of bogeys assembled as a single Train.

desc: 一次性连续放/一次转弯最多放多长轨道。默认32 —— 注意: 你当前设为128
en: Maximum length of track that can be placed as one batch or turn.

desc: 动力列车最高速度。默认40
en: The top speed of powered Trains.

desc: 动力列车转弯最高速度。默认20
en: The top speed of powered Trains during a turn.

desc: 列车加速度(方块/秒²)。默认3
en: The acceleration of any assembled Train.

desc: 组装列车最高速度(方块/秒)。默认28
en: The top speed of any assembled Train.

desc: 列车转弯时最高速度。默认14
en: The top speed of Trains during a turn.

desc: 行驶中的火车是否会撞伤玩家和生物
en: Whether moving Trains can hurt colliding mobs and players.

worldgen.disableWorldGen.zh: 关闭 Create 世界生成
desc: 关闭 Create 添加的全部世界生成内容(否则保持默认 false 即可)
en: Prevents all worldgen added by Create from taking effect
